gaps: The deployed image contains only the HTTP entrypoint; no deployed stdio capture exists. In-memory source-server tests are not deployed stdio evidence.
The captures exercise the identified image locally with synthetic data and an ephemeral issuer, not the external production or preproduction ingress.
The HTTP capture preserves five not_wired_yet stubs and 404 raw-data responses. Simulation results are stored separately and are not evidence of wired production behavior.
mcp-auth 0.1.0 advertises /mcp/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Its root router alone does not expose /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp.
The captured server forwards the original bearer for search_signals. API receiver enforcement is implemented separately; MCP exchange/cache and secure live cutover remain pending.

Missing coarse scope immo:read returns HTTP 401 invalid_token with the deployed mcp-auth 0.1.0. With mcp-auth 0.2.x (0.2.2 fix, RFC 6750 section 3.1) the same case becomes HTTP 403 insufficient_scope; after that upgrade the hosted client must not be asked to reconnect (UAT criterion).
